name: Adversarial Review
summary: Adversarial code review using cross-model approach. Spawns reviewers on the opposing model (Claude uses Codex, Codex uses Claude) to challenge work from distinct critical lenses. Produces a synthesized verdict with findings and lead judgment. Triggers: "adversarial review".

name: Unslop
summary: Remove AI writing patterns from prose. Use for docs, READMEs, blog posts, any non-code text that should sound human. Triggers: "unslop", "humanize", "make this sound human", "clean up this writing", "edit for voice", "de-AI this text".
